Circular asset graphs are valid and generate normal wiring; the assets
build handles strongly connected component hashing at application startup.
-- go.mod --
module app

go 1.27

require github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/assets v0.0.0

replace github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/assets => ASSETSDIR
-- main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- web/assets.go --
package web

import "embed"

//fabrik:assets
//go:embed all:assets
var Assets embed.FS
-- web/assets/a.js --
import "./b.js";
-- web/assets/b.js --
import "./a.js";
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/assets"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"

	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		r := router.New()
		assetCompiled, err := assets.Build([]assets.Root{
			{FS: web.Assets, Dir: "assets"},
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		// Register
		r.Handle("/assets/", assetCompiled.Handler())
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
